summary: First-finish smoke pass for Andhra News (Telugu news portal). Backend: 6/6 critical endpoints working (news list, categories, login, /auth/me, admin news list, full CRUD with Telugu content). Frontend: 9/9 flows working (home layout, category nav, article detail, admin login with prefilled creds, admin dashboard listing 12 rows, create article with Telugu title/body, public visibility of new article on /category/sports, delete article, logout + redirect to /admin/login). End-to-end admin CRUD -> public visibility flow verified.
passed: POST /api/auth/login returns access_token + user; sets cookie
GET /api/auth/me protected endpoint works with Bearer token
POST /api/admin/news creates article with Telugu text (పరీక్ష వార్త) and persists correctly (UTF-8)
Homepage renders: ABN logo, flash news marquee, blue category nav (Home/Politics/Sports/Cinema/Business/Technology/Health/Photos/Videos), hero + 34 article links
Category page /category/sports loads with 10 sports cards
Admin login form has prefilled admin@news.com / admin123; submit redirects to /admin
Admin dashboard shows all 12 rows with New Article + Logout buttons
New Article modal creates article with Telugu title 'పరీక్ష UI వార్త' and Telugu body; article appears in admin list
Newly created published article visible on public /category/sports page immediately
Delete action removes article from admin list
Logout clears session; visiting /admin redirects to /admin/login
notes: Image upload to Emergent object storage (POST /api/admin/upload) and edit-article flow were not exercised in this smoke pass; recommend covering in the full testing pass. All critical paths (admin CRUD -> public visibility, Telugu content, auth) verified working end-to-end.
